    <div class="row">
      <div class="col-md-6">
        <p class="mb-3 psjustify">We offer various room categories to suit every individual taste. Whether you prefer a family room, double room with sea view, twin room, or a budget-friendly dorm bed - everyone will find their perfect accommodation here. Each room is uniquely decorated and equipped with WiFi and either a fan or air conditioning. In all rooms, you can freely choose between double beds or single beds. Our room rates include a breakfast buffet and use of the kite station - separate storage, compressor, outdoor showers, large pool, beachboy service, and expansive lawn area for launching and landing right by the water at the widest point of the lagoon.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="col-md-6">
        <p class="mb-3 psjustify">The separate kite storage and daily transfers to the low-tide kite spot are already included in the price. Our pousada also features a swimming pool, cozy hammocks, a co-working space with lagoon views, a pool table, foosball table, and a large restaurant and bar area. We also have a projector for live sports broadcasts. Free WiFi is available throughout the entire property. We look forward to welcoming you to Ilha do Guajiru. By the way: We source 100% of our electricity from our own solar energy system.</p>
      </div>
